**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the mergers with Axioma and Domos, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Market Units are where SimCorp meets its clients – and the commercial engine behind them is what turns strategy into growth. As Head of Global Commercial, you will lead the global commercial organisation that powers our front-line Market Unit teams, including Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing.

Reporting to Oliver Johnson, Chief Revenue Officer, and working as a peer to our regional Managing Directors, you will lead a commercial transformation with a clear top-line focus: making our Market Units more effective, more productive and better equipped to win. The role is based in EMEA – in London, Copenhagen or Frankfurt.

Success in this role means Market Units that spend more of their time with clients, a commercial organisation where AI and data are part of how every team works, and a commercial model that scales with SimCorp’s growth.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Commercial transformation: Define and lead a transformation agenda that makes SimCorp’s Market Units across all regions more efficient, scalable and growth-oriented

• Commercial organisation: Lead and develop Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing, ensuring each function directly supports front-line performance

• Top-line growth: Improve pipeline generation, sales productivity, win rates and deal velocity across the Market Units

• Operating model: Review and optimise the commercial team set-up and operating model, so people, resources and investment are focused on the highest-impact growth opportunities

• AI and data: Embed AI, automation and data-driven insight into commercial processes – from forecasting and territory planning to enablement and marketing execution

• Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, partner with regional Managing Directors and Market Unit leaders, and establish a commercial cadence and KPIs that give leadership clear transparency on performance

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

• Experience leading a commercial team transformation end-to-end, with measurable improvements in productivity and growth

• Significant experience driving commercial performance and value creation; scaled experience in Financial Services, Private Equity or Software

• Deep knowledge of financial services and the investment management software market, including the buy-side client landscape, market dynamics and competitors

• Senior leadership of commercial functions such as Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and/or Marketing, across multiple regions and cultures

• An AI-native mindset, with hands-on experience applying AI, automation and modern go-to-market tooling to commercial teams

• Leadership that builds and inspires high-performing teams, makes difficult decisions with clarity and empathy, and influences senior stakeholders in a matrix organisation

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Michael Paterson, Talent Acquisition Partner, at MLPN@SimCorp.com . If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

At Struers, we help companies and laboratories around the world understand their materials and make confident decisions about quality. Our purpose is Ensuring Certainty, and behind the equipment that delivers that certainty is increasingly sophisticated software.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to help develop the machine-control software behind our next generation of products.

Our machine-control platform is based on modern PLC technology, but this is not a traditional PLC programming role. We approach machine control as a software engineering discipline, applying principles such as structured architecture, modularity, reuse, design patterns, automated testing, and maintainable code.

Whether your background is embedded software, automation, control engineering, C/C++, C#, or PLC development, we are interested in strong software engineers who enjoy making software interact with the physical world.

You will contribute from early concepts through product launch, developing reusable software components, machine behavior, and control algorithms, and validating your solutions directly on real machines.

Key Responsibilities:

• Implement machine control and process logic for Struers machines.

• Design control algorithms and implement software designs based on input from software architects.

• Develop and improve reusable software modules and libraries for Struers machines.

• Apply modern software engineering principles to create robust, modular, testable, and maintainable machine software.

• Test and verify software directly on real machines and equipment.

• Work closely with mechanical, hardware, and project teams.

• Participate in R&D product projects from concept phase to product launch.

• Contribute to code reviews and analysis of other developers’ work.

• Establish required design, test, and product documentation.

• Support handover of product software and documentation to the engineering department responsible for product and platform maintenance.

• Collaborate with international software colleagues, including the Czech software team.

• Demonstrate the ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and cost efficiency.

• Identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.

Requirements:

Education & Experience:

Must-have:

• Relevant engineering degree or similar technical background.

• Hands-on software development experience.

• Ability to develop structured and maintainable software.

• Experience from at least one relevant software development technology, for example, C/C++, C#, Java, PLC programming, or another structured or object-oriented programming language.

• Interest in automation, machine control, PLC-based systems, embedded software, or industrial software development.

• Ability and motivation to work with physical equipment and test software on real machines.

• Good communication skills in English, both spoken and written.

Nice-to-have:

• Experience with machine control, process logic, automation systems, or control/regulation.

• Experience with object-oriented programming.

• Experience with Structured Text or PLC programming.

• Experience designing or implementing control algorithms.

• Experience from industrial equipment, machinery, production equipment, or similar domains.

• Experience working in international engineering teams.

Professional skills:

• Structured and analytical approach to software development.

• Ability to understand software designs and implement them in a maintainable way.

• Ability to work close to physical products and solve practical engineering problems.

• Strong collaboration skills across software, hardware, mechanical, and project disciplines.

• Ability to take responsibility for implementation tasks within product projects.

• Interest in building robust, reusable, and maintainable software solutions.

• Good communication skills and ability to contribute positively in an international team.

• Self-motivated and focused on moving tasks toward completion.

• Curious and willing to learn Struers’ products, domain, platform, and development practices.

Success Criteria:

• High-quality machine-control software is delivered according to project needs and the agreed software architecture.

• Machine control and process logic are implemented in a structured, maintainable, and reusable way.

• Software is tested and verified systematically on real machines and equipment.

• Reusable software modules and libraries contribute to reduced development time across projects.

• Software design and implementation meet relevant quality, maintainability, cost, and compliance expectations.

• The role contributes positively to collaboration between software, mechanical, hardware, and project teams.

• The role contributes to effective collaboration across locations, including with the Czech software team.

• Product software and documentation are handed over in a structured way to the engineering department responsible for product and platform maintenance.

About the Business Unit

Struers is an AMETEK business unit and a global leader in materialographic and metallographic solutions, providing equipment, consumables, software, and services for material testing, sample preparation, and hardness testing. Its technologies help manufacturers, research institutions, and laboratories analyze materials and ensure the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance across industries such as aerospace, automotive, electronics, energy, and advanced manufacturing.

Founded in 1875 in Denmark and headquartered in Ballerup, Denmark, Struers has more than 150 years of expertise in material science and a global presence with offices and support teams worldwide. Known for its strong application knowledge, innovation, and customer-focused approach, Struers helps organizations achieve accurate and reproducible material analysis results that support product development, quality control, and scientific advancement.

**Job Description

**Our infrastructure relies heavily on external partners, managed service providers, and vendors. We're looking for someone engaged, who will ensure that our suppliers deliver as agreed in terms of scope, budget and schedule.

In this role, you will be the person who holds suppliers accountable, runs the operational reviews, and steps in before a delayed delivery or an unresolved ticket turns into a business problem.

You will work closely with the HO IT Infrastructure to ensure that services are performing as expected.

**What The Job Is

**

• Run operational vendor management: Act as the primary operational contact for our infrastructure and network suppliers.

• Enforce SLAs and deliverables: Track performance metrics closely. When a supplier misses an SLA or slips on a deadline, you address it early and drive the remediation plan.

• Lead structured reviews: Chair regular service reviews (monthly/quarterly), track action items, and ensure unresolved operational issues are followed through to completion.

• Partner with IT Procurement: Provide the operational data needed for contract renewals, dispute discussions, and vendor scorecards.

• Handle escalations: Intervene when standard operational channels stall.

**How Will You Contribute To The Team

**

• Proven background: Solid experience in a Service Delivery, Vendor Management, or IT Operations role within an enterprise environment.

• Infrastructure knowledge: A practical understanding of enterprise IT (cloud hosting, networks, on-prem hardware, data centers, security platforms). You must be able to follow technical discussions, challenge timelines and spot when a vendor is giving vague answers.

• Commercial and contract awareness: Hands-on experience working against contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), and strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• Communication style: Firm, diplomatic, and articulate. You need to be able to say "no" or "this isn't acceptable" clearly and professionally.On the other hand, you would also be able to build good relations to continue the good corporation with our suppliers

• Languages: Professional fluency in English (written and spoken). Danish language skills are a plus. Structured as a person (especially in written form).

**Pluses (not Hard Requirements)

**

• Practical knowledge about ITIL frameworks

• Daily experience working on platforms like ServiceNow, and Jira.

• Experience operating within multi-vendor setups and international organizations.

• Financial understanding

We’re looking for a hands-on finance leader to own and build our finance function as we scale. You’ll work side by side with our founders and leadership team on strategic decisions, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. This is for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and who wants to have a big impact on how we scale in the future.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**You’ll be a key strategic leader at Pandektes, shaping our current financial setup and optimising it for scale.

We’re looking for a commercially minded finance leader who thrives in high-growth environments and understands what it takes to scale a company from early traction.

You will own and evolve the finance function end-to-end; from building scalable financial infrastructure to partnering closely with our CEO and board on strategic decisions. You’ll combine sharp financial thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring we have the insights, structure, and capital needed to scale responsibly and ambitiously.

As part of the leadership team you’ll play a key role in scaling Pandektes. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategic finance and operational execution.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own and evolve Pandektes’ financial strategy, ensuring our financial setup scales with our growth ambitions

• Act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO and leadership team on company-wide decisions

• Set up and continuously improve operational finance processes, systems, and controls

• Fully own business performance metrics, in particular providing insight into key SaaS indicators to drive business performance, support strategic decision-making and identify opportunities for profitable growth

• Own company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning

• Work with external partners on accounting, audits, compliance etc.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Significant experience in high-growth startups or scale-ups, ideally in a VC- or PE-backed environment

• Proven track record leading or playing a central role in fundraising (Series A/B/C and beyond) and/or M&A processes

• Solid understanding of operational finance, including setting up finance functions from scratch or early stage

• Deep experience in excel modelling with a proven track record of delivering automation to manual and complicated processes

• Comfort in dealing with transactional level detail where required in advance of automation and process improvement

• Proven experience with budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn financial data into clear business insights

• You are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in fast-moving environments

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Hamburg, London and Zurich. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• A central office in Copenhagen, where you can work closely with an ambitious and growing team

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

About Be My Eyes

Be My Eyes is on a mission to make the world more accessible for the 340 million people who are blind or have low vision. Our apps connect people with volunteers, companies and AI through live video, free of charge, so they can handle the inaccessible parts of everyday life at home and at work.

The idea came from Hans Jørgen Wiberg, a Danish craftsman with low vision. The app launched in 2015, drew 10,000 volunteer sign-ups in its first 24 hours, and now has millions of volunteers helping in more than 180 languages. Today our products include the Be My Eyes app, Be My AI, Be My Eyes for Smart Glasses, the Service Directory and Be My Eyes for Desktop.

We build products with our community, not just for it, and their needs come first even when that challenges our own assumptions. We move fast, care about the details and take ownership of what we ship. We see mistakes as part of pushing boundaries, and we take kindness seriously while keeping room for fun.

Read more about our story

About the role

You'll own the "how" of product development. The role sits where engineering leadership meets hands-on technical work: you'll lead engineers across mobile, web and backend, and stay close enough to the code to make real technical calls.

You'll partner closely with Product and Design to ship software that blind and low vision users depend on daily. You'll also grow the people on your team, so they leave each year stronger engineers than they started it.

Small team, global impact

Few places let you work on a small team and still reach millions of people. Our whole product and engineering team is about 12 people. What we ship directly shapes the quality of life of blind and low vision people around the world.

We're also working to reach the rest of the 340 million people who are blind or have low vision, wherever they live and whatever device they use. Our tools are free for the people who rely on them. We build them to improve lives, not to make a quick profit.

For your career, that means rare scope. Your decisions reach real people fast, and you'll see the difference your team makes.

What you'll do

• 
Set technical direction, and give the team ground-up context on how product decisions shape implementation

• 
Manage and develop a team of 5–6 engineers across iOS, Android, web and operations

• 
Be the technical fix-it person when problems fall through the cracks

• 
Partner with the CTO, VP of Product and Head of Design to plan and deliver work

• 
Drive engineering quality across AI-powered features, mobile apps and infrastructure

• 
Keep projects moving across competing priorities, without losing sight of what matters to our users

What we're looking for

• 
4+ years in software engineering and engineering leadership

• 
Strong enough technically to read code, make architectural calls and unblock engineers

• 
A track record of developing engineers — coaching them and growing their careers, not just managing their work

• 
Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities

• 
Real care about accessibility and about building with the people who use what you ship

Nice to have

• 
Lived experience as a blind or low vision person

• 
Experience shipping iOS or Android apps that work well with VoiceOver or TalkBack

• 
Experience building or running AI- or LLM-powered product features

• 
Hands-on time with Python/Django, React or Kubernetes

• 
Familiarity with accessibility standards such as WCAG

Open to everyone

We welcome applicants of every age, gender and ability. If you don't tick every box above but the role excites you, we'd still like to hear from you.

Lived experience as a blind or low vision person is a real strength on our team. It brings first-hand insight into how our products work in daily life, which leads to better decisions about what we build and how.

Connected Cars is on an ambitious mission to connect millions of vehicles through real-time data, enabling safer and more sustainable mobility. Our team of ~70 people is driven by a shared belief in community, team effort, and quality solutions.

The Position

As we rapidly scale across international markets, we are looking for a Head of Support & Training. Exceptional support and structured customer training are core drivers of our product adoption. Sitting within the Commercial team, you will lead a dedicated technical product support team of 5, act as a proactive operational bridge for our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to help them translate technical solutions into tangible customer value, and drive the onboarding strategy for 15–20 international Customer Interaction Centre (CIC) stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Team Empowerment & Leadership: Mentor and develop a team of 5 Product Support Specialists (including one fully remote). After our in depth onboarding, you will step back from daily ticket execution to empower the team, delegating ownership of strategic projects and functional areas so they can grow as independent, proactive professionals.

• Proactive Commercial Enablement: Partner closely with Sales & CS, moving beyond reactive troubleshooting to actively equip CSMs with the technical insights and operational backing needed to unlock customer value and drive account expansion.

• Technical Escalations: Serve as the senior escalation point for complex enterprise issues across our hardware, telematics, and app ecosystem, ensuring prompt root-cause resolution.

• Enterprise Partner Governance: Lead the onboarding and training of 15 -20 international CIC and market support leads, ensuring local operations can support our product at scale.

• Zendesk Architecture: Own and optimize our Zendesk setup - designing efficient ticket routing, automation, SLAs, and performance metrics.

• Training Frameworks: Collaborate with Product & Brand Marketing to create scalable training templates and academy materials for internal teams, external CICs, and end-users.

What You Bring

jobs.description:
About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

Getting a promising treatment into a clinical trial takes more than good science. Patients need medicines and delivery devices they can rely on, made to the right standards and available when needed.

As Associate Director, QA Drug Product & Device, you'll own quality oversight of our drug product manufacturing partners and combination product development. You'll work closely with CMC, Manufacturing and device development colleagues to resolve quality risks, keep clinical supplies moving and build the quality framework Hemab needs as its pipeline advances.

What you'll do

• Ensure QA oversight of selected drug product CDMOs and fill-finish activities in collaboration with the CMC and Manufacturing team

• Ensure QA oversight of design controls and risk management for combination products, including review and approval of design control deliverables, in line with 21 CFR Part 4 and EU MDR Article 117

• QA review and approval of master and executed batch records, specifications, protocols and reports

• Oversee and manage drug product deviations, CAPAs and change controls

• Ensure batch documentation is complete and release-ready, and support the Qualified Person in the certification and release of drug product and combination product batches

• Create and review quality agreements with drug product CDMOs and suppliers

• Advise and support the CMC and Manufacturing team as quality lead for selected programs

• Participate in building and improving fit-for-purpose quality systems and processes as Hemab grows, and contribute to projects across Quality and the wider organization

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Hands-on QA experience with combination products or drug-device products, including design controls and ISO 14971 risk management

• Experience overseeing drug product CDMOs, ideally aseptic fill-finish, including audits and quality agreements

• Working knowledge of EU GMP (including Annex 1), 21 CFR Parts 210/211 and 600-610, and 21 CFR Part 4 and ISO 13485.

• A collaborative, cross-functional working style, partnering closely with CMC & Manufacturing, device development, supply chain and regulatory colleagues

• Good communication skills. English is our company language, so you are comfortable writing and speaking it professionally

• A solution-oriented and hands-on way of working, comfortable taking ownership and shaping processes as the organization evolves.

Nice to have Eligibility, or a realistic path, to act as an EU Qualified Person

• Experience with prefilled syringes, autoinjectors or other injectable delivery systems

• Danish language skills

What to expect, honestly

You'll be accountable for quality, but much of the manufacturing happens outside Hemab. That means working through CDMOs, sometimes with incomplete information, competing timelines and decisions that cannot wait. You'll need to know when to challenge, when to escalate and when there's enough evidence to move forward.

Drug product manufacturing and device development don't always move at the same pace. A late deviation, an unresolved design control issue or missing batch documentation can affect clinical supply. You'll need to get close to the detail, work directly with partners and find a compliant way forward.

Some of our quality frameworks are still being built. You'll help establish them while managing today's work. If you prefer established systems and clearly separated responsibilities, this may be frustrating. If you enjoy building sensible ways of working that protect patients without slowing good decisions, there's room to make a real difference.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

We're adding a Clinical Trial Manager to take ownership of study delivery as our clinical portfolio grows. You'll be responsible for turning clinical development plans into well-run trials, keeping sites, CROs and internal teams focused on what matters: enrolling patients, protecting their safety and generating reliable data.

Based in Copenhagen, you'll work closely with Clinical Operations colleagues and teams across both locations. This is a hands-on role with room to shape how we run studies as Hemab grows.

What you'll do

• Take ownership of the day-to-day delivery of assigned clinical trials, from start-up through close-out, against agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.

• Drive site activation and patient recruitment, working with investigators and CROs to identify obstacles early and find practical solutions.

• Manage CROs and external vendors, holding partners accountable for their commitments and addressing performance issues directly.

• Develop and maintain study plans, timelines and risk assessments that give the team a clear picture of progress and what needs attention.

• Work closely with Clinical Development, Medical, Regulatory, Data Management and Quality colleagues to resolve study issues and keep decisions moving.

• Oversee study budgets, forecasts and vendor expenditure, identifying potential overruns before they become problems.

• Maintain compliance with ICH-GCP, study protocols and applicable regulations, with inspection readiness built into everyday trial delivery.

• Help establish practical ways of working that can be used across studies without adding unnecessary complexity.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Experience managing interventional clinical trials, with direct responsibility for study delivery and oversight of external partners.

• A working knowledge of clinical trial start-up, site management, recruitment, monitoring and close-out.

• Experience addressing recruitment delays, site performance issues or other challenges that threaten study timelines.

• Sound knowledge of ICH-GCP and the regulatory requirements governing clinical trials.

• Experience managing CROs, study budgets and timelines, with the judgement to know when to escalate an issue.

• The ability to work effectively with colleagues across clinical, scientific and regulatory disciplines, including when priorities change.

Nice to have

• Experience in rare diseases, haematology or coagulation.

• Experience working in a smaller biotech company or helping establish clinical trial ways of working.

• Experience with international, multicentre clinical studies.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. Whoever takes this role will likely build some of their own process instead of inheriting a finished one. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

We value people who take responsibility when something goes wrong, ask for help when needed and work without ego. At our size, how you work matters as much as where you've worked. Good structure should help people move faster and trust each other, not create more work.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an Incident Manager to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response domain.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 440 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an Incident Manager who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.

CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)

Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in the Nordics. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.

The Role

As a Cyber Incident Manager, you are responsible for coordinating incident engagements from initial response through containment, forensic investigation, recovery, and post-incident activities.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams consisting of forensic investigators, recovery specialists, infrastructure experts, legal advisors, and customer stakeholders. At the same time, you will act as a trusted advisor to customer representatives throughout the incident lifecycle.

Your focus will be on driving progress, aligning priorities, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring that response and recovery activities move forward efficiently. You will gradually be taking on increasing responsibility as you develop your leadership, stakeholder management, customer advisory, and crisis coordination capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate cybersecurity incident response engagements.

• Act as a primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders during incidents.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams consisting of technical and business specialists.

• Drive recovery efforts to minimize business disruption and downtime.

• Provide guidance and recommendations throughout the incident lifecycle.

• Support customers in strengthening resilience and preparedness after incidents.

• Contribute to the continuous development of Truesec incident response capabilities and methodologies.

Your Potential Background

We believe you have a background in cyber security, IT operations, managed services, consulting, technical account management, service delivery, project coordination, or a similar field.

You enjoy collaborating with both technical specialists and business stakeholders, bringing structure to challenging situations and helping teams to prioritize the work toward a common goal.

Required Skills

• Understanding how modern IT environments and services are operated and supported.

• Experience leading major incidents, service disruptions, or crisis situations.

• Experience advising senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

• Ability to build trusted relationships with technical specialists and business stakeholders.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic mindset.

• Professional proficiency in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience

• Experience within cybersecurity incident response, digital forensics, SOC operations, or managed security services.

• Understanding of compliance, regulatory, legal, and information protection requirements.

• Background in consulting or customer-facing advisory roles.

• Experience with cloud security and hybrid IT environments.

• Knowledge of cyber risk management, business continuity, and resilience.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship or citizenship in another EU country. Language skills in English and Danish is required.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

**Who is Understory?

**Understory is a vertical-focused software platform built for experience businesses – from kayaking tours to cooking classes. Our operating system helps creators manage operations, grow bookings, accept payments, and run their business with clarity and less stress.

We move fast, iterate quickly, and expect everyone to bring proactive solutions every day. You'll learn faster here than almost anywhere else because the challenges are real and the pace is high. This isn't about clocking in and out - the right candidate will get a lot of trust and ownership, and it's all about building something that matters to creators around the world.

We recently raised a €12M Series A and are scaling fast. With customers in 10+ countries and a growing presence in Europe, our focus is global, our ambition is high, and our team is fully committed to becoming the go-to platform for experience creators worldwide.

**About The Role

**As our Nordic SDR, you'll own outbound in our Nordic markets - generating qualified leads and building relationships with potential customers for our Account Executives. You'll bring energy, structure, and a high standard to your outreach, and you'll contribute directly to revenue growth while sharing valuable insights on local market dynamics.

You'll research and connect with experience providers – from tours and classes to events and local activities – and turn conversations into booked meetings. You'll also help sharpen our playbooks and raise the bar for how we approach outbound.

**What You'll Do

**

• Identify and research potential customers (experience providers, venues, activity operators) in Denmark and Sweden.

• Execute a high-volume outbound strategy across calls, email, and LinkedIn.

• Qualify leads and schedule meetings for Account Executives.

• Maintain accurate lead and prospect data in CRM; track progress and report insights.

• Share learnings about the Nordic markets - local trends, competitor activity, and cultural preferences.

• Collaborate with marketing and product teams to refine messaging and support growth.

**What Success Looks Like

**Months 1–2 - Ramp & Launch: Complete onboarding; start booking initial meetings; hit full productivity by week 8.

Month 3+ - Consistent Flow: 40+ demos per month derived from outbound outreach.

Ongoing - Revenue Generation: Generate a pipeline that converts to closed revenue (quality over quantity).

**What We're Looking For

**

• You need to be native in one of our Nordic markets: native level of Danish, Swedish or Norwegian, plus fluency in English (written and spoken).

• Strong communication and outreach skills; proactive and well-organised.

• High coachability and resilience; you view feedback as a growth tool and "no" as just a step toward your next "yes".

• Deep business curiosity; you love understanding how companies work and tailoring your approach to solve their unique problems.

• Cultural sensitivity and ability to adapt pitches to the Danish, Swedish or Norwegian markets.

• Passion for experiences, travel, and the experience economy.

• Self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment.

• Someone living in either Copenhagen or Barcelona to join one of our offices.

**Nice To Have

**

• Network within the tourism, travel, or events industries in Denmark or Sweden.

• Familiarity with experience-booking platforms, hospitality, or SaaS.

• Experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot or Gong.

**Why You'll Thrive at Understory

**

• Join a small, ambitious team where your insights directly impact pipeline growth.

• Work in a collaborative environment with autonomy, trust, and flexibility.

• Learn fast and grow fast - the challenges are real, and the pace is high.

• Be part of a mission-driven company redefining the experience industry worldwide.

**Start Date & Application

**We review applications on a rolling basis and will hire as soon as we find the right person.

Start date: We're always on the lookout for great candidates, so don't hesitate to apply.

If you have any questions about the role or the process, feel free to reach out to Hugo at hugo@understory.io.
